## Football effect

Poyer finished the game: the record logs the injury at the end of Detroit's possession at 4:39 of the second quarter with no removal, and he played the third-quarter block (the interception of Orlovsky's throw to Ebron, returned 27 yards) and the fourth-quarter block with pairing C, plus the kickoff coverage (two tackles). The instruction after the game is out, and on the projection he misses the August 23 to 25 practices and is reassessed August 23; the August 26 projected return precedes the August 28 game, and his availability for Atlanta follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. The nickel work in the three games (53, then 47 defensive snaps, no recorded substitution fault) stands as recorded; the reserve nickel rotation while he is out follows the record, not a pre-assignment. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
